integrity: Exact pre-existing raw-energy and squared-sum mixed moments are excluded from novelty; the finite two-root and sharp double-boundary results are the sole new claim. Same-model proof and program checks are not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: At least two positive-correlation roots for n>=7, but not uniqueness; pointwise asymptotic limits only; historical priority not independently resolved, full Lindgren article inaccessible.
title: Two boundary layers for zero-crossing and centered-energy covariance in Gaussian AR(1) samples
